title: THE CROWN SPIRE
notes: COHERENCE (2026-10-22): ch6 is the Crown dam, crossed once from the road to the floodgate: a0 THE DAM TERRACES is the dam road, a stone causeway over the reservoir with the drowned city beyond (E7a0 0-1216 only), a1 THE DAM GALLERY is the torch-lit gallery inside the dam face, its gates and chains above the turquoise sluice water (E8a1 608-1376 only), a2 THE CROWN FLOODGATE goes on along that gallery into the sluice basin (E8a1 1024-1792: the same stone and water, the basin opening between its piped walls). Each area walks back and forth through its source strip (legs <= 512 px, leftward legs mirrored), so every join is a mirror join or a continuation; the place changes only at the fades and never goes back.

Palette (the dam): every slice is recoloured into quiet grey masonry (saturation 0.45-0.5, 25% toward #7a8090), the gallery's iron doors become brass sluice gates (row 6: hue +30, 35% toward #c8a040) and the water turquoise (E8a1 row 4: 30% toward #30c8b8; the reservoir in E7a0's far layer, row 23, 45% toward #2ab0a0); the far layer keeps the storm dusk (s3ops) with the runtime lightning and rain.

Lanes: the E7a0 causeway deck (y 113-160) is walk-patched one row onto its front coping (floor art), lane 64; the E8a1 gallery ledge (rows y 128-192, floor art) is walk-patched onto the wading strip below it, lane 96, in a1 and a2.

Boss arena (6-6, MARSHAL SABLE / CROWNBACK): the floodgate basin itself: turquoise water between the dam's piped walls, brass sluice gates set into the basin walls (the E8a1 door, lifted, in brass), the gallery's chains; the runtime adds the spill wheels and the Crown set pieces.

Section casts (CAMPAIGN §4.4 'cast', merged over the chapter pool): lighter A/BOMB/KNIFE variants where the ROM-affine HP budget of the chapter's waves exceeded ENEMIES §2.6 by more than 15% (tests/campaign.cjs (8)); ratio now 1.139.

Priority: the E7a0 causeway is drawn with prio "none" (its front coping is a foreground row in 1993, and the widened lane runs over it). Far layer: E7a0's reservoir and drowned city under the storm in all three areas (past the road, through the gallery openings, beyond the basin).
